# Julen De La Serna

> Julen De La Serna is a filmmaker and director of photography in Vitoria-Gasteiz. Music videos, documentaries and branded content across the Basque Country.

I'm Julen De La Serna, a filmmaker and director of photography based in Vitoria-Gasteiz. I direct and shoot music videos, documentaries and branded content for artists, brands and production companies across the Basque Country. Based in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Basque Country.

## Pages
- [Work](https://julendls.com/): selected music videos, documentaries and other pieces
- [About](https://julendls.com/about/): who he is, how he works, equipment and clients
- [Contact](https://julendls.com/contact/): start a project
